name: DrillingFluidInventoryTracker
tagline: Mud stock, reorders, rig-to-rig transfers and cost per well – one plug-and-play Power Apps component.
description: A complete drilling-fluid inventory app for drilling contractors and operators: stock on hand per rig from a posted ledger, reorder points and days of cover, an approval-controlled ledger, cost per well and hole section against budget, and a requisition and transfer board. Drop it on a canvas screen or a model-driven form and it works immediately with demo data.
features: Ledger-based stock on hand per rig and yard
Reorder points, max stock, days of cover and overstock
Prefilled reorders and bulk reorder requests
Approval threshold and status rules with stock checks
Void with reason, locked posted rows, undo
Cost per well, hole section, day and product vs budget
Search, quick filters, grouping, bulk actions, CSV export
